items.text: Eikoo oloiboni le Nkai oji Mikaia Ahab
Ore apa too larin okuni netoni iltung'ana le Israel o le Siria te seriani.
Kake ore to lari liokuni nelotu Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda enetii olaiguanani le Israel.
Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli isinkan lenyena, “Iyiololo intae aajo enaang oshi Ramot-gilead, naa eikigira oshi iyiook, mikiyieu nikiya aaoru olaiguanani le Siria?”

Nejoki Ahab Yehoshafat, “Eikiriamariyie iyie nanu pee kipuo olarrabal te Ramot-gilead.” Nejoki Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Atiu ake nanu enitiu, netiu iltung'ana laainei anaa enatiu iltung'ana linono, netiu mbartan aainei anaa nkuninono.”
Nejoki Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Tang'asa naa nkilikuanu ororei oing'uaa Olaitoriani.”

Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrur iloibonok le Nkai tenebo, oobaya iip ong'uan, nejoki ninche, “kalo nanu olarrabal aarare Ramot-gilead anaa aimalo?” Nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik o laiguanani.”
Kake enyaaka Yehoshafat ajo, “Aimeekure etii ene likae oiboni lo Laitoriani likinkilikuanishore?”

Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Eton etii oltung'ani obo likindim aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani. Mikaia olayioni le Imla, kake kaiba nanu ninye amu maaibonoki aekata ninye embae sidai, ntorrok ake aaibonoki.” Nejo Yehoshafat, “Mincho olaiguanani ejo neijia.”
Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aipotu oltung'ani kitok nejoki, “Toriku ntasieku Mikaia olayioni le Imla.”

Ore apa ina kata netonita olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani le Yuda too lorikan lenye le nkitoo, etukusote too lkilani lenye. Netoni ninche te wueji neidong'ishoreki tembata enkishomi e Samaria. Neibonisho apa iloibonok pooki te dukuya ninche.
Ore Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neitobiraki kewan imouarak e sekenkei, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Te kuna ipuopuo intae aarrumoo iltung'ana le Siria ometaba anaa neidak.’ ”
Neibonisho iloibonok pooki aaiko neijia, nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo Ramot-gilead timirisho; amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik olaiguanani.”

Ore ilo tung'ani apa oirriwayioki meshomo aipotu Mikaia nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, ore irorei loo loibonok pooki naa eisidain tialo olaiguanani; nchoo irorei linono metotiwuo anaa irorei liobo lenye, niro mbaa sidain.”
Kake etejo Mikaia, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ina naajoki nanu Olaitoriani ninye alo airo.”

Ore ake pee elotu ninye enetii olaiguanani, neikilikuan olaiguanani ninye ajoki, “Mikaia eikipuo iyiook olarrabal te Ramot-Gilead anaa aimikipuo?” Newalu ninye ajo, “Shomo timirisho, amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik olaiguanani.”
Kake etiaka olaiguanani ninye, “Ae katitin aja nanu aaikilikuan pee iro esipata ake te nkarna Olaitoriani?”
Enki 27.17
Mat 9.36
Nejo ninye, “Atoduaa nanu Isiraeli pooki eidapashate too ldoinyo anaa ntare nemeeta olchekut; nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Meeta kulo olaitasheikinoni, nchoo ake errinyo pooki ng'ae enkang enye te seriani.’ ”
Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie meibonu ninye embae sidai, kake entorrono eibonu?”
Isa 6.1
Yoa 1.6
Neitoki Mikaia ajo, “Entoning naa ororei lo Laitoriani: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani eton to lorika lenye le nkitoo. Ore olorora pooki le shumata neitashe te mbata enye te nkalo e tatene o te kedienye.
Nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kaing'ae ilo olo alej Ahab, meilepa ninye alo metaari metua te Ramot-gilead?’ Nejo ake oltung'ani embae nabo nejo olikae enkae bae.
Nelotu enkiyang'et naishu aitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, ‘Kalo nanu alej ninye.’
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, ‘Kaitiaa oitoi?’ Nejo ninye, ‘Kalo nanu aaku ololejisho too nkutukie oo loibonok pooki.’ Nejo ninye, ‘Ilo iyie alej ninye naa ilo aidimu ninye, shomo naa taasa ina.’
“Ore naa taata, ng'ura etipika Olaitoriani oltau le lejare kulo oibonok pooki; eimaka Olaitoriani embae torrono tialo iyie.”
Nenyiku Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neosh Mikaia eseder, nejoki, “Kaji eiko enkiyang'et o Laitoriani tenepuku te nanu nelotu airo te iyie?”
Nejo Mikaia, “Ng'ura, ilo kenya adol teina olong nilo ajing'ie olgilata liaji isudori.”
Nejo ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Embung'a Mikaia eyaki Amon olbalusui le nkanasa, o Yoash olayioni lo laiguanani;
nipuopuo aajo, Nji ejo olaiguanani, Entipik ena tung'ani atua korokoroni nintotiti ninye too mukateni o te nkare ake ometaba anaa narrinyunye te seriani.”
Nejo Mikaia, “Tenirrinyunye iyie te seriani, neitu naa aairorie nanu Olaitoriani.” Neitoki ajo, “Entoning lo tung'ana pooki!”
Keeya e Ahab
Kaae nelo apa olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda Ramot-gilead.
Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Kalo nanu anapa pee alo olarrabal, kake nchopo iyie ilkilani linono le nkitoo.” Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli anapa nelo olarrabal.
Neitanap apa olaiguanani le Siria lelo arikok le pokira tomoni uni oare loo ngarrin oo mbartan, ejo, “Emiaar oltung'ani kitok aashu oloti, kake olkitok loo Siraeli ake entaar.”
Ore ake pee edol lelo akedok loo ngarrin oo mbartan Yehoshafat, nejo, “Esipa olaiguanani le Israel.” Kaae neibelekenya aarare ninye, neyietu Yehoshafat aishir.
Ore ake pee edol lelo arikok loo ngarrin oo mbartan ajo mme olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neibelekenya aapuo te sujaroto enye.

Kake eteyietuo oltung'ani obo enkawuo enye, neng'or olaiguanani loo Siraeli eripata e long'o enye, to lgoo. Ore enkaraki ina nejoki olaiguanani ilo arewani le ngarri enye oo mbartan, “Mbelekenyayu, iwaki matung'uai olarrabal, amu aatipikaki olbae.”

Neirowuaju olarrabal ina olong, neigarakino olaiguanani engarri enye eing'or enkalo oo ltung'ana le Siria. Ore pee eaku teipa neye ninye, ore osarge leina ng'oroto neiput oltiren leina garri oo mbartan.
Ore etaa kedoyio enkolong neibulu olkiyioi enkop pooki, eji, “Shomo pooki tung'ani enkanasa enye, nelo pooki tung'ani enkop enye!”
Kaae neaku etua olaiguanani, neyauni ninye Samaria; nepuoi aanukaa ninye te Samaria.
Nepuoi aaituku ina garri oo mbartan to lchorro le Samaria nemej ildiain ilo sarge lenye, ore nkituaak naaibor onyek neituku ate teilo sarge, te risioroto eilo rorei le Nkai apa oiroro ninye.

Ore nkulie kiaasin e Ahab, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o ina aji oo lala loo lkanchaoni apa natesheta ninye, o nena anas pooki apa naatesheta ninye, neigero tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Kaae neirura Ahab neye anaa loo menye, neitoreisho Ahasia te rishata enye.
Olaiguanani Yehoshafat le Yuda
Neiteru Yehoshafat olayioni le Asa aitore Yuda to lari liong'uan le enkitoria e Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli.
Oloo larin tomoni uni o imiet apa Yehoshafat pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Asuba entito e Shilhi.

Nerubare ninye orrekie le Asa Papaai lenye, eitu ninye eibelekenya apaash easata oo mbaa sidain te dukuya Olaitoriani. Ore ake eyia eitu eyai iwuejitin neeika, ore iltung'ana neitayu ilasarri nepej enkorropil te nena wuejitin neeika.
Eitobira sii apa Yehoshafat osotua o laiguanani loo Siraeli.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoshafat, oina kidimata enye naitodolua, oina nashomo olarrabal, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.
Ore olpisiai le lelo ooibor onyek apa ootelekutua too nkolong'i e papaai lenye, neishie ninche teina kop.
Meetae apa olaiguanani te Edom; olaiguanani oti ninye apa etegeluaki
neitobir Yehoshafat imelin e Tarshish pee epuo Ofir aayau sahabu; kake eitu ninche epuo, amu eidaaitie nena melin te Esiong'eber.
Neitoki Ahasia Olayioni le Ahab ajoki Yehoshafat, “Nchoo isinkan laainei epuo tenebo isinkan linono too melin.” Kake eitu enyorraa Yehoshafat.
Neirrag Yehoshafat airura neye anaa loo menye, nenukari te nkurare oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Yehoram olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Olaiguanani loo Siraeli oji Ahasia
Neiteru Ahasia olayioni le Ahab aitoreisho te Isirael te Samaria to lari le tomon oopishana le nkitoria e Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye ilarin oare te Israel.

Etaasa apa ninye embae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, nerubare orrekie le papaai lenye, o rrekie le ng'otonye, o rrekie le Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, laa ninye apa oitapong'oyie Isiraeli metaasa eng'oki.
Eisiaayia apa ninye Baal neserem ninye, neitagor Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, te pooki oitoi apa nataasa menye.
